source_title: Days after Theni jailbreak, Tamil Nadu Prisons DGP Sandeep Rai Rathore transferred
source_excerpt: CHENNAI A couple of days after the sensational jailbreak in Theni district in which 17 prisoners escaped and were later apprehended, the Tamil Nadu government transferred the Director-General of Police, Prisons, Sandeep Rai Rathore. 17 remand prisoners escape from sub-jail in Theni district; 13 held so far storyline 1 ECI appoints Sandeep Rai Rathore to head Tamil Nadu police; new Commissioners of Police for Tambaram, Madurai storyline 1 He was posted as DGP/Chief Vigilance Officer, Tangedco, Chennai. K. Shankar, ADGP, Enforcement Bureau-CID, was posted as the ADGP, Prisons and Correctional Services. The Theni jailbreak was the second instance of inmates escaping from a prison. Two prisoners escaped from Puzhal Central Prison on October 20, 2026, and were apprehended the next day. Seven assistant jailers were suspended for the alleged security lapses. They slipped out in batches. The daring escape sent shock waves as the camp was guarded by five watchtowers and two companies of the Central Reserve Police Force that assisted the Tamil Nadu Police TAMIL NADU INFOCUS In the Theni district jail, 17 remand prisoners allegedly overpowered jail staff members and escaped on the night of Monday (October 26). Special teams that were formed to track the escapees nabbed 13 of them on Tuesday and the remaining four on Wednesday (October 28). Dr. Rathore visited the jail and ordered the suspension of nine prison wardens for dereliction of duty. All 17 escapees from Theni district jail apprehended in less than 40 hours: IGP South Zone storyline 1 Stung by the two jailbreaks, he initiated measures to strengthen the prison security protocols. Armed wardens were deployed in the watch towers of all prisons with authorisation to open fire in the event of an attack or jailbreak. Mr. Shankar, who is due for elevation as the DGP in January next, has already had a short stint in the Department of Prisons as its ADGP.
